title: Four SQL-script targets are classified as symbolic notation instead of code

evidence.qp_wording: Each target explicitly asks for a Structured Query Language (SQL) script.
evidence.taxonomy_boundary: The accepted calibration taxonomy defines CODE as executable/declarative code such as SQL and SYMBOLIC_NOTATION as formal expressions or register-transfer notation.
evidence.current: All four rows use SYMBOLIC_NOTATION/CONSTRUCT; the first three are grouped in PC-B24-039 and the fourth in PC-B24-108.

required_action: Change response_product to CODE, retain source-specific SQL evidence needs/dependencies, and rebuild affected pattern and variant metadata before independent retest.

title: Two sensor-use marking rows lose the official row-atomic pairing condition

evidence.official_condition: 1 mark for sensor and matching purpose to max 2
evidence.problem: The single mark is conditional on a matched sensor-purpose pair, not an independently scoreable listed point.

evidence.official_condition: 1 mark for sensor and its use in this system
evidence.problem: Each mark requires the sensor-use pair; the bullets cannot be treated as separate point-based criteria.
